scope: Read-only semantic review of SOURCE-CONVERSION-R1, timestamp amendment R2, and legacy-migration/summary closure R3 against the accepted source-publication compiler, assessment-history, source-association and preservation contracts. No production, test, Git, Vault, network, operator or external-process mutation.

source_publication_delivered_base.status: provided exact committed source-publication baseline; not relabelled by this review

actual_contract_checks.evidence: R3 requires SOURCE_CONVERSION_UNSUPPORTED_CHANGE before staging when a preserved upgraded-paper claim remains evidence-empty. This matches canonical_compiler_v2._versioned, which rejects every versioned claim without evidence; a formerly empty claim may proceed only when explicit section mapping supplies valid new evidence and the v2 invalidation chain.

R3 defines historical retention as exact legacy raw/parser/run/source inventory bytes. It does not invent a v2 active-extraction history field; without a display decision v2 display_head and active-extraction mirrors remain null, while source_state._legacy_artifacts continues to validate the retained legacy artifact inventory.

R3 distinguishes unchanged paper/repository records and claim history from compiler-regenerated pages. canonical_compiler_v2 may update an unrelated rendered page for changed cross-paper concept links; those page bytes are explicit payloads and remain covered by collect_source_state, complete-page validation and SOURCE_PUBLICATION_UNSUPPORTED_CHANGE for retirement.

The final review binds the effective R1 section map exactly: summary→one_sentence_conclusion (core=true only), method→method, architecture→representation_architecture, training_data→training_data, experiments→experiments_results, limitations→limitations, code_resources→code_resources, open_questions→research_question; unknown sections produce no claim.

R3 makes created, invalidated and unchanged IDs pairwise disjoint sorted sets whose union is exactly the IDs produced by selected provisional sections. Location migration is an independent non-created set and may overlap the other categories.

R3 freezes source-conversion-v1 as actor/decided_by and gives exact genesis and invalidation reason templates. It also forbids a new event whenever profile/fingerprint is unchanged, even if the light record ID changes.

R3 requires associate_source to receive the complete inventory and selects by the complete observation/version key plus exact raw and registration proof, never source_id alone or display_head. This matches source_versions.associate_source and its existing version/provenance conflict refusals.

R3 requires supplied DOI/arXiv values to normalize to the canonical paper ID or an already present alias, which is necessary because existing aliases are immutable and canonical_compiler_v2 validates explicit identifier bindings for v2 records.

R1/R3 refuse an unrepresentable uncited legacy source ID. This matches canonical_compiler_v2._versioned requiring source_ids to equal the sorted union of association/evidence source IDs, and source_state._ownership requiring every v2 claim ledger location to use ^<claim_id>.

R1/R3 preserve unchanged v1 event bytes and append exactly one v2 system evidence_invalidation when evidence profile/fingerprint changes. This matches assessment_history_v2 mixed-chain rules and prevents a second genesis or synthetic human review.

R2 fixes proposed_at to whole-second UTC. Changed source/claim ledgers, paper records and appended events check chronology and persist proposed_at; unchanged no-op validates grammar only and persists no timestamp/request.

R1 freezes complete-tree mirror/all-exit verification, path-independent light validators, one retained Vault session and the exact 13-path allowlist. No additional writable source or schema path is required by the resolved semantic contract.

implementation_watchpoints: Freeze JSON must bind all three conversion contract hashes, the allowlist hash, and the delivered source-publication base before implementation.
Implementation acceptance must prove the exact R3 summary partition, reason strings, source-association disambiguation, empty-evidence refusal, and no-op timestamp behavior in focused tests.
Implementation acceptance must retain the complete lightweight tree and selected source/authority/metadata inputs through success and exception paths, with WORK_PATH_UNSAFE precedence unchanged.
